### Hi, I'm Daniel Queiroz 👋

Full-stack developer based in Goiânia, Brazil. I build web products end to end, from typed APIs and databases to responsive interfaces, CI pipelines and deploys. These days I mostly work with TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, building on a background in PHP, Laravel and Delphi.
